subject.title: feat(chat): rewind and fork a session from a message bubble

question: Should OpenClaw expose rewind and fork as permanent public `sessions.*` RPCs and Control UI actions, with the stated admin/write authorization split and persisted-session lifecycle semantics?
rationale: The patch introduces a user-facing session branching mode and additive public gateway protocol surface; correctness fixes alone cannot establish whether that long-term product contract is desired.

options.title: Sponsor the feature after repairs
options.body: Keep the public RPC and UI direction, but require the protocol, delivery-state, proof, and lifecycle concerns to be resolved before merge.

options.title: Narrow to an internal experiment
options.body: Remove or defer the public protocol exposure until the session-branching API contract is explicitly designed and documented.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Pause the PR if session rewind/fork should not become a supported Control UI and gateway capability now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the feature after repairs
recommendation.body: Keep the public RPC and UI direction, but require the protocol, delivery-state, proof, and lifecycle concerns to be resolved before merge.
